drafts.subject: Re: Regarding the project delay
drafts.body:
Dear Director Liu,

Thank you for your email and for bringing this matter to our attention. I apologize for the delayed response.

Here is an update on the project:
1. Current progress: 75% complete.
2. Anticipated delay: 2 weeks.
3. To expedite, we can allocate additional resources and work overtime.

Please let me know if this plan is acceptable or if you have any further concerns.

Best regards,
[Your Name] | [Your Company]
